title: AI Product Background Changer | AIVideosUGC
description: Change a product photo background from one clear image. Keep the item recognizable, create a new setting for listings or ads, and avoid another studio shoot.
h1: AI product background changer for a new setting
lead: Remove the old background and put a studio surface, a counter, or a seasonal scene behind the same product photo. Credits are what you spend on a photo, and you see that cost before you start.
secondary_keywords: replace the background of a product image
steps_h2: How to change a product background in 3 simple steps
steps_lead: Upload the item, name the new setting, and download a finished photo.

steps.d: Add one photo that shows the whole item. A clear shape around the item helps the new background meet it cleanly.
Name one surface, room, or outdoor place. Keep the note short so the product stays easy to see.
Compare the new setting with the original photo. Download the square image for the store or the ad editor.

benefits.alt: Matte blue ceramic vase on a clean pale wood studio table against a warm neutral wall.
benefits.d: One photo costs 24 credits, shown before you start. If the photo fails, those credits come back. You can also make several backgrounds from that same photo.

benefits.alt: Matte blue ceramic vase on a simple seasonal shelf with oatmeal linen and muted green foliage.
benefits.d: The shape should still match the photo you uploaded. Small printed words can change, so compare them before you publish.

benefits.alt: Matte blue ceramic vase on a shaded garden table with oatmeal linen and soft green foliage.
benefits.d: You download a square photo with the new setting filled in, and no watermark (no logo stamped on the file). It is not a see-through file with an empty background.

faq.q: What is an AI product background changer?
faq.a: It keeps your product photo and replaces the setting around the item. You describe the surface or the room, then download a new image.

faq.q: Can I make a new background for an Etsy photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one product photo, name the surface or the room, and download the square image. The cost shows before you start.
The item should keep its angle and shape. Compare it with the real product, because small printed words can change.

faq.q: Do I get a see-through background?
faq.a: No. You download a finished photo with the new setting already filled in. For a plain main photo, make a separate white image.
Simple surfaces keep attention on the item: light wood, stone, linen, or one quiet color. A busy scene makes the product harder to see.

faq.q: Can I use the new photo in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, so no logo is stamped on the file. You can use it for your business. Add any price or offer in your ad editor.

faq.q: Can I choose a seasonal or outdoor setting?
faq.a: Yes. Name one room, surface, or outdoor scene, such as a holiday shelf or a shaded table.

faq.q: How is this different from a new photo shoot?
faq.a: A new photo shoot needs space and lights. Here the new setting comes from a photo you already own. If that photo is blurry, start with [how to take product photos for AI](page:guide-product-photo-tips).

faq.q: Do you include a free background library?
faq.a: No. There is no free plan and no free set of backgrounds. Pick a studio, wood, or garden scene on this page, or describe your own surface. Each photo is 24 credits. If the photo fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can the new photo become a video?
faq.a: Yes. Open [URL to video](page:url-to-video) from a product link, or [image to video](page:image-to-video) from the photo. Add a written script, a spoken AI voice, on-screen captions, and music. Then publish to TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram).

faq.q: Can I edit the photo without another app?
faq.a: Yes. The editor here can add a short line of text, crop the photo, or write the line in another language. You do not have to open a separate editor.
